**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers found; two notes, both non-blocking.

## What looks good

- The rule is applied with one mechanism and one exception list: `.ok()`/`let Ok(..)` on a checked constructor goes through `Ctx::checked`, which keeps the kind and the reason; the stage still tries the next place, and the reasons go to the notes of the entry that fits (`entry: a try of the <kind> was refused by its check - <reason>`) or to `Refusal::after`/`tried()` (`; tries refused: ...`).
- The two exit checks share one `check_retract` (finite, >= 0, at or above the finite material top), and the converter refuses an exit under the clearance height instead of raising it in silence. The fallback of an exit with no lead-out is a named `Fallback` (`arc lead-out` -> `straight retract`, with the reason), written to the notes.
- The `geo()` helpers give `<STAGE>_GEOMETRY` for `OutOfRange` and a new `<STAGE>_GEOMETRY_INVALID` for `Invalid`, through one `geo_refusal`. The unoriented centre is refused (`NOT_ORIENTED`) instead of being made normal again, with its pin on the loops (`a_loop_against_its_nesting_is_found`).
- The pins are real: `no_silent_entry` and `no_silent_exit` join the `laws` binary through `#[path]` lines (no new top-level binary), and the motion-side pins cover the clearance refusal, the fallback notes and the empty arc.
- The two crate edges are documented in `docs/decisions/4407-pathkernel-dependency-edges.md` with the imported items, why the caller cannot pass them in, and what rebuilds; the record of #4024 in `RECOMMENDED.md` ("Dependency decision") is cited, not duplicated.
- The ~50 citations of `docs/decisions/4024-path-kernel-design.md` were re-pointed to `RECOMMENDED.md` `## #4024`; the only remaining mention is the historical "Why" section of that heading, which is the record itself.
- Merge is clean with the base `side/path-kernel` at `21fd9e57d` (`git merge --no-ff --no-commit origin/side/path-kernel`: "Already up to date"; the laws.rs provenance conflict was resolved by keeping the side branch's wording, as the body says).

## Where it ran

Not on the runner: the PR touches a `Cargo.toml` (comment lines), which the PR test workflow refuses (step 2b). Local build in worktree `cc-pr4437-review`, base `side/path-kernel` `21fd9e57d`, head `81a91983882db88e16488a23bd3ea0d6371e0f8c`, on this machine with `sccache`.

## Results

- `cargo check --tests -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-pathkernel -p camcraft-motion`: ok
- `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --lib`: 100 pass, 0 fail
- `cargo test -p camcraft-pathkernel --lib`: 7 pass, 0 fail (the two lib pins and five others)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-pathkernel --test laws`: 177 pass, 0 fail (the four `no_silent_*` pins included)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib kernel_emit`: 10 pass, 0 fail
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test kernel_laws`: 32 pass, 0 fail (k3 READ, k4 LIFTS/CROSSINGS, k6a unchanged)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test pass_start_levels`: 45 pass, 0 fail
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-pathkernel -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

## Targeted checks

- No post or toolpath change (the kernel is behind the switch, default old): no `example_catalog*` suite was run.
- P2 PR: no heavy step is owed. No `heavy-wave` record is required (its absence is not a finding).
- Light lane: 15 light twin(s) of the heavy tests, in release - **green** (see the note below).

## Notes

- Light lane: **green**. `cargo xtask gate light --base origin/side/path-kernel` completed steps [01]-[06] (build 3s warm; motion light: lib 404s; adaptive_troch_island 127s; adaptive_troch_neck 20s; adaptive_troch_parallel 13s; pocket_pass_start 2s - all ok) before its own 590-second cap stopped it inside [07] (offset_pass_start). The 3 remaining twins were then run with the exact command the gate prints for that step (`cargo test --release -j 24 -p camcraft-app --no-fail-fast --test offset_pass_start -- --test-threads=24 --ignored fig8_adaptive_2d_readings_of_the_old_planner_light fig8_offset_2d_readings_of_the_old_planner_light fig8_pocket_3d_readings_of_the_old_planner_light --show-output`, 32.94s): all 3 pass. With [01]-[06] ok and [07]'s 3 twins passing, all 15 light twins are green.
- The decision file lists `region::OPEN_NEEDS_SIDE` as an imported item of `machining2d/kernel_region.rs`; the file imports `REGION_GEOMETRY` only (`OPEN_NEEDS_SIDE` is used by `kernel_region_tests.rs`). Minor doc inaccuracy, not a blocker.
- `entry/stage.rs:238` and `load/trochoid.rs:227`: a refused stage does not carry the trochoidal-pitch note (the note is added only to the `Done`/`Incomplete` verdicts). A refusal is a refusal — the named reason carries the status — so this is noted, not requested.
- The `exit()` in `entry/exit.rs` propagates the error of `arc_onto` (a fault of the arc itself) rather than naming a fallback; the lead-refusal is the one that is named. Consistent with the decision file ("any other refusal of the lead is a fault, and it names the fallback" — the fault itself is a refusal).

## Requested before merge

None that block the merge.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The `Exit::new` signature change (a third `top` argument) is a public API change with no callers outside `pathkernel`/`motion`; it is not a project-format or post-output change, so no `!` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer is needed.
- The body says the laws.rs conflict was kept as the side branch's wording; the laws suite itself was reviewed by the side branch and passes (177).
- The `no_silent/` directory is outside `laws/`, which the body explains (the #4406 work) and which is not a new top-level binary.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
